map_role: Hollow Crescent Ring Depot — concave twin-grade freight interchange, basin settlement and five entered calibration/repair districts

anchor_donors.name: wide-tungsten-sawtooth-tramworks
anchor_donors.relationship: Shared industrial steel/amber signal semantics and recoverable tram switching; no source geometry, wheel, baffle, route, name or coordinates reused

macro_topology: Five-tier U-shaped load-bearing basin; opposed outer and inner bowed tram grades joined at distant side returns
Five full-hull relief cut-throughs cross the interchanges; support towers have distinct asymmetrical base elevations
Rooted freight/dispatch/repair facilities on both rims, in the basin and in open subterranean bays
density_profile: Both basin rims and the southern workshop pockets are equipped while the central aerial crescent remains deliberately sparse; long upper sky sightlines and vacancies retained for editing.

route_grammar.primary: West arrival (111,515) through the outer bowed transfer and upper crescent crest (988,284), eastern signal master (1580,390) and outbound finish (2022,555)
route_grammar.secondary: Inner low-grade spillway with supported braces, basin dispatch (1026,820), five full-envelope opened excavation shafts and service escape sites
route_grammar.obstruction: A 96x115 source-material closure at [1120,240] occludes only Physical severable midspan (1168,290); 24/25 other exact centres remain connected at conservative 31x27. The Outer bow crest to Outer eastern crest shortest 31x27 path grows from 449 to 565 (+116) steps.

strong_motifs: Deep concave municipal freight basin rather than separate islands or long horizontal boulevard
Two unequal bowed grade-lines with cut-through transfer gaps, not an engineered rotor
Braced twin-leg viaduct support families anchored into five different bedrock elevations
Grounded ram plant, nonrotating inner shunting gantry and remote asymmetric brake telegraph
Five intentionally unfinished subterranean repair shops connected by physically traversable relief slots
interesting_relationships: Aerial outer switching is mirrored by interior lower recovery but faces five different ground elevations
Load-bearing piers create usable separate dispatch/settlement underfaces
A high grade closure can coexist with a functioning lower basin and all five entered shops
Unused lower bays and aerial grade gaps act as module attachment opportunities
authoring_affordances: Wide central crescent void for future Gentek modular assemblies
Five unfinished entered underworks for manual human improvement
Two opposed grade returns suitable for example-derived switching variants
Static gantry attachment sockets for later scripted rescue, cargo or signal scenes
procedural_exemplar_value: Concave multilevel support/route grammar; layers contain real cross-passages
Site-defined closure and documented conservative branch detour
Workshops under different founder heights demonstrate shaft-to-room relationships
Gaps and service rooms deliberately remain partial for human and procedural embellishment
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Switchglass 01's civic boulevard, 02's uphill geological cascade, 03's separated estuary islands and Meridian's rotor/chicane families, this is a single massive concave grounded depot with interleaved internal/external grade routes and five relief passages. Its repeated vertical voids are physical clearances, not alternating sawtooth baffles.
